name: applicationcostprofiler
description: This reference provides descriptions of the AWS Application Cost Profiler API.

subcommands.name: delete-report-definition
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified report definition in AWS Application Cost Profiler.

subcommands.name: get-report-definition
subcommands.description: Retrieves the definition of a report already configured in AWS Application Cost Profiler.

subcommands.name: import-application-usage
subcommands.description: Ingests application usage data from Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3).

subcommands.name: list-report-definitions
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all reports and their configurations for your AWS account.

subcommands.name: put-report-definition
subcommands.description: Creates the report definition for a report in Application Cost Profiler.

subcommands.name: update-report-definition
subcommands.description: Updates existing report in AWS Application Cost Profiler.
